title: Nodule-region radiomics predicts spread through air spaces in lung adenocarcinoma
summary: 333 patients with part-solid nodule lung adenocarcinoma from three hospitals were studied retrospectively, with one institution used for training (n=223) and the other two as an external test set (n=110). CT radiomic features from ground-glass, solid, gross and perinodular regions were used to build SVM, LightGBM and logistic regression models. In the external test set the LightGBM model combining ground-glass, solid and perinodular features reached an AUC of 0.840 (95% CI 0.758-0.921), better than the clinical model (AUC 0.622). The cohort is modest and retrospective.
